first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person walking forward along the bridge with their back to the camera, wearing a tawny pointed wide-brimmed hat, with a long braid, and dressed in a gray-green long-sleeved top, a dark vest, and a dark brown long skirt.

entities.name: Layered Rocky Hills
entities.identification: The rocky hill behind the far end of the bridge, with stepped rock strata and protruding rock ledges.

entities.name: Blue Sky and White Clouds
entities.identification: The pale cyan-blue sky and large expanses of white clouds in the upper part of the frame.

entities.name: Tall Grass by the Bridge and Vegetation on the Grassy Slope
entities.identification: Patches of green grass blades beside the bridge and on the slope on the right, including the purple flower spikes in the right foreground, but excluding the trees atop the hill.

entities.name: Distant Flat-Topped Mountain
entities.identification: The blue-gray distant mountain behind and to the left of the Layered Rocky Hills, with a relatively level top and relatively steep mountain walls.

entities.name: Gray-Blue Stone-Slab Bridge Deck
entities.identification: The long, narrow path converging toward the far end between the stone railings on both sides; gray-blue stone slabs and the joints between them are visible in the middle and far sections, while a rough, dark surface is exposed at the near end.

entities.name: Reddish-Brown Stone Railings on Both Sides of the Bridge
entities.identification: The low reddish-brown stone railings on both sides of the bridge deck; repeated arched openings are clearly visible on the left, and there is moss on the top surfaces of the stone blocks at the near end.

entities.name: Dark Boulder on the Right
entities.identification: The large dark-gray, nearly black boulder on the upper part of the slope on the right, with an irregular top edge and a brighter rock face on the right.

entities.name: Rocky Slope on the Right
entities.identification: The rocky slope descending steeply outside the right railing, exposing inclined rock strata and dark fissures and partially occluded by vegetation.

entities.name: Blue-Gray Water Surface on the Left
entities.identification: The blue-gray water surface outside the left railing and below the canyon rock wall, with horizontal light and dark textures.

entities.name: Canyon Rock Wall on the Left
entities.identification: The tall gray-blue rock wall behind the water surface on the left, with its distant contours fading into the mist.

entities.name: Tall Tree and Small Tree atop the Rocky Hill
entities.identification: Two trees, one tall and one short, atop the Layered Rocky Hills, with the small tree on the image-left of the tall tree.

entities.name: Group of Flying Birds in the Upper Left
entities.identification: Two small dark flying birds in the upper-left sky in the first frame, one of them closely adjoining the image-left edge.
